messages:
elaine: Quick design review — uploaded a new mock for the Playground streaming row. Put a mini token-peek in the top-right corner of the chat pane and a prompt quick-launch tray that appears on hover. link: https://figma.com/file/xyz sam: Saw it, looks neat. Two quick questions: (1) top-right token peek vs token footer? (2) what happens on mobile / narrow widths? :iphone: mohit: For mobile I was thinking the token peek collapses into the overflow menu, same as compact controls. Top-right keeps it visually separate from the input affordance which helps parity with dedicated console pages. kevin: Concern: streaming updates + token counter in top-right might be noisy for screen reader users if we update it per token. We should throttle announcements or use aria-live politely. lisa: +1 to throttle. Maybe announce on generation start/finish and when token count crosses thresholds (e.g., +500). Also keyboard access: stop/regenerate must be reachable via single shortcut and focusable control. elaine: Good catch — accessibility is priority. Proposed behavior: token peek updates visually each chunk but aria-live only fires on start/finish and when final token count reached. Also the stop button gets a visible focus ring and `aria-pressed` states for streaming vs paused. sam: Prototype note: add `title` tooltip for token peek with exact count and a copyable breakdown (prompt / completion) in a flyout. For low-vision users the flyout should be keyboard-navigable. mohit: Implementation sketch for aria-live we discussed: ```html
Streaming…
``` We'll keep per-chunk rendering separate from the live region to avoid SR spam. kevin: Also recommend role="status" for small screen readers? Might be duplicative. We should test with NVDA/VoiceOver. lisa: Keyboard mapping suggestion: `Ctrl+.` to stop streaming, `Ctrl+,` to regenerate last response. Add a small tooltip that lists shortcuts in the prompt tray. elaine: UX decision poll: top-right token peek + hover prompt tray vs bottom token footer + persistent prompt button. cast votes please (thumbs up = top-right, thumbs down = bottom/footer). mohit: 👍 top-right (keeps chat input area cleaner). sam: 👎 bottom/footer (easier reach on mobile, predictable focus order). kevin: 👍 top-right if we do SR-friendly announcements and keyboard focus path is documented. lisa: 👎 bottom/footer because of mobile ergonomics. elaine: Tally: 2 thumbs up, 2 thumbs down, 1 neutral (aria-bot silent). Looks split. Action: I'll make two tiny prototypes (top-right and footer) and run a quick usability pass next week. aria-bot: Reminder: accessibility testing slot booked Fri 10:00 with QA (NVDA/VoiceOver). sam: For the prompt quick-launch tray: we should allow pinning favorite prompts and show token estimate per prompt. If a pinned prompt would exceed a threshold show a warning before generation. mohit: Token estimate can use the same estimate service we use for evals. UI: small gray estimate next to each prompt label, e.g., "~120 tokens". kevin: Edge case: regen + different model variant might change token accounting. Make sure the estimate shows model scope (gpt-2 / 2x) so users know variance. elaine: Great. Final items: 1) Sam prototype both placements, 2) Mohit wire up aria-live pattern, 3) Kevin run SR checklist during QA slot, 4) Lisa draft microcopy for token tooltip and shortcuts. I'll post updated Figma when prototypes are done. sam: Logged as a small task in the sprint board. PRD note: keep default to top-right for desktop and footer for mobile unless testing strongly favors otherwise. lisa: Microcopy suggestion for token tooltip: "Token estimate includes prompt + expected completion. Actual usage may vary." Keep it short. elaine: Thanks all — small follow-up: add an acceptance criterion for no more than 2 SR announcements per generation. Closing thread for now, will reopen with figma link and prototype timestamps.
